    new_grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Define toggle zones
    zone_a_triggers = [(45, 21), (38, 21)]
    zone_b_triggers = [(46, 21)]
    zone_c_triggers = [(24, 38), (24, 45)]
    zone_d_triggers = [(24, 44)]
    
    # Define cost 2 triggers (static)
    cost_2_triggers = [(42, 18), (24, 41), (21, 41), (52, 9), (9, 52), (44, 63)]
    
    # Check if the click is a toggle action
    if (x, y) in zone_a_triggers:
        toggle_zone_a(new_grid)
        cost = 1

        toggle_zone_b(new_grid)

        toggle_zone_c(new_grid)
        cost = 1
    elif (x, y) in zone_d_triggers:
        toggle_zone_d(new_grid)
        cost = 2
    elif (x, y) in cost_2_triggers:
        cost = 2
    else:
        cost = 1
    
    decrement_counter(new_grid, cost)
